pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/libs/libcap/libcap.git https://kernel.googlesource.com/pub/scm/libs/libcap/libcap.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" a1fef85d27d0ee12729a64d1c9b2183c6007e56a; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = a1fef85d27d0ee12729a64d1c9b2183c6007e56a
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach a1fef85d27d0ee12729a64d1c9b2183c6007e56a
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "a1fef85d27d0ee12729a64d1c9b2183c6007e56a: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

set -x
make BUILD_CC=gcc CC=gcc lib=lib prefix=/usr PAM_CAP=no DESTDIR="${{targets.destdir}}"
make sbindir=/bin lib=/lib prefix=/usr RAISE_SETFCAP=no PAM_CAP=no DESTDIR="${{targets.destdir}}" install
chmod 755 "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/libcap.so.${{package.version}}"

set -x
mkdir -p "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/usr/bin
for i in capsh getcap getpcaps setcap; do
  mv "${{targets.destdir}}"/usr/bin/$i "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/usr/bin/
done
rmdir "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin"

pipeline.name: Test getcap reads file capabilities
pipeline.runs:
# Query capabilities on a known binary; output may be empty if none set
getcap /usr/bin/capsh

pipeline.name: Test setcap sets and getcap reads back capabilities
pipeline.runs:
cp /usr/bin/capsh /tmp/test-capsh
setcap cap_net_raw+ep /tmp/test-capsh
getcap /tmp/test-capsh | grep -F "cap_net_raw"
# Clear the capability
setcap -r /tmp/test-capsh
rm -f /tmp/test-capsh

pipeline.name: No PAM module, and nothing loads libpam
pipeline.runs:
cat > /tmp/libcap-probe.sh <<'WEREWOLF_LIBCAP_PROBE'
# The installed libcap holds Werewolf's build policy: no PAM module, and no
# library that loads libpam. libcap-utils, tested by Wolfi's own steps, links
# only these libraries.
set -eu

if [ -e /usr/lib/security/pam_cap.so ]; then
	echo 'libcap installed pam_cap.so' >&2
	exit 1
fi
found=
for file in /usr/lib/libcap.so.* /usr/lib/libpsx.so.*; do
	test -e "$file" || continue
	found=1
	if grep -q 'libpam\.so' "$file"; then
		echo "$file names libpam" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
done
test -n "$found"
WEREWOLF_LIBCAP_PROBE
sh /tmp/libcap-probe.sh
